title: Use of nylon slings in conjunction with climber or tower crane erection, jumping, climbing, and dismantling.
officialText: Nylon slings shall only be used in conjunction with climber or tower crane erection, jumping, climbing, and dismantling if the manufacturer’s manual specifically states or recommends the use of nylon slings. Nylon slings shall not be used unless softening mechanisms have been applied to all sharp edges.
